'''Dragonfly men''' are [[animal people]] variants of the common [[dragonfly]] who can be found in [[savage]] [[pool]]s. They spawn in groups of 2-5 individuals and are generally content to keep to themselves, but may pick fights if provoked. In terms of size, they are a little over half the weight of the average [[dwarf]]. All dragonfly men are born with Legendary [[skill]] in [[Climber|climbing]].

Currently, dragonfly men are unable to appear in game, since they spawn only in pools and ponds, and only [[vermin]] creatures can spawn inside the borders of a map.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] dragonfly men for their ''faceted eyes''.
